title: Coriander Seeds

seo.title: Coriander Seeds (Dhania) - Benefits, Uses and Safety
seo.description: Learn about coriander seeds, or dhania, including their botanical identity, Ayurvedic properties, traditional uses, benefits, dosage and safety considerations.

short_description: Coriander seeds are aromatic seeds traditionally used as a culinary spice and in Ayurvedic preparations to support digestion and cooling balance.
full_description: Coriander seeds, commonly known as dhania, are the dried fruits of Coriandrum sativum. They are widely used as a culinary spice and have a long history of use in traditional Ayurvedic preparations, particularly for supporting digestion and helping to balance excess heat.

recommended_dosage.extract: Use only as directed by a qualified practitioner

ayurvedic_properties.dosha_effect: Traditionally considered balancing for Pitta and supportive for Vata; it may be used for Kapha in moderate amounts.

key_benefits.benefit: May help soothe occasional digestive discomfort and bloating.
Traditionally used to support a balanced response to excess heat.

therapeutic_uses.use: Traditionally used for indigestion, reduced appetite and occasional abdominal discomfort.
Used in digestive spice blends, infusions and decoctions.
Used in traditional preparations intended to support cooling and urinary comfort.

safety_and_contraindications.safety: Use moderate amounts; excessive intake may cause digestive upset in some people.
People with allergies to coriander or other Apiaceae family plants should avoid it.
People taking medicines or using concentrated preparations should consult a qualified healthcare professional first.
